Creators
● Influencer marketing

Influencer marketingchosen for fit, notfollower count.

Creators shortlisted for audience fit, briefed against one idea, contracted with clear usage rights, and read against sales.

See how it works

In short

Influencer marketing is the work of partnering with creators whose audience matches your buyers, so their content introduces and recommends your product.

Monday Marketing Company (MMC) plans influencer and creator partnerships for D2C brands, and can reuse the best content as paid ads.

  • Fit over reachCreators chosen for who follows them, not how many.
  • Tracked properlyLinks and codes so results can be read against sales.
  • Rights agreedTerms that allow the best content to run as ads.
Where influencer marketing goes wrong

Five ways creator budgets are wasted.

Creators can introduce a brand well or waste a budget. Each stage below is where it goes wrong, and how we run it.

  1. 1
    Stage 1 of 5Choose for fit

    Picking creators by follower count.

    A large audience that does not match your buyer produces reach, not sales.

    What we do

    We shortlist creators by audience fit, engagement quality and past content, and check them before you commit.

    Creator shortlisting
  2. 2
    Stage 2 of 5Brief around one idea

    Sending a product and hoping for the best.

    Creators know their audience, but need to know the one thing you want said, and what to avoid.

    What we do

    We write clear briefs around a single brand idea, leaving room for the creator's own voice.

    Creative briefs
  3. 3
    Stage 3 of 5Agree the terms

    Paying for a post with no rights to reuse it.

    If you cannot run the content as an ad, you lose its best use.

    What we do

    We agree deliverables, timelines and usage rights up front, including the right to run the content as ads.

    Contracts and usage rights
  4. 4
    Stage 4 of 5Track it to sales

    Judging campaigns on views and likes.

    Views do not show whether anyone bought. Links, codes and blended sales do.

    What we do

    We give each creator tracked links and codes and read results alongside your total sales.

    Tracking and attribution
  5. 5
    Stage 5 of 5Reuse the best

    Letting a great post disappear after a day.

    A post that earned attention organically often works as an ad too.

    What we do

    We take the best creator content, with agreed rights, and run it as paid ads.

    Content reuse as ads

Common questions

What people ask about influencer marketing first.

What is influencer marketing?

It is the work of partnering with creators whose audience matches your buyers, so that their content introduces and recommends your product.

How do you choose creators?

By audience fit, engagement quality and past content, not by follower count alone.

Do you handle contracts?

We help agree deliverables, timelines and usage rights. Legal review of contracts is for your own advisers.

Can you reuse creator content as ads?

Yes, when the usage rights are agreed up front. It is often the best use of a strong post.

What about paid-partnership disclosure?

Creators need to disclose paid partnerships as advertising rules require. We build that into every brief.

What does it cost?

It depends on scope and, for media, on ad spend, so we quote after the audit call, once we have seen your accounts.
